description: On the tabletop there’s a small red plate in the center, a scattered pile of colorful plastic utensils to the right, and a yellow squeeze bottle near the far right edge. The left hand holds a fork near the plate while the right hand grips a blue sponge, pressing it onto the fork’s prongs and handle and sliding the sponge back and forth to scrub; the fork stays mostly steady in the left hand as the right hand repeatedly moves the sponge along it.
